rulings.evidence: spaghetti-squash is already a live board commodity at 4 of 7 stores, cheapest 1.49 at Baker's, so this is a REUSE and not a proposal - only the vocabulary row is missing. Whole-squash weight taken (2 x 2 lb as the source states) because the halved shells are the serving vessel and the whole gourd is what is purchased; that weight also lands the carbs within 1 g of the source's published figure.

macro_cross_check.note: Recipe totals 1897 cal / 161.6 g protein at source scale. Protein within 4% and carbs within 1 g, so the whole-squash weight is right; the calorie gap is the loosest of the three and sits inside the 15% bar. Band check on our numbers: 474 cal (24 over the 450 floor), 36.0 carbs (4 under the 40 ceiling), 40.4 protein (0.4 over the 40 floor). This recipe passes on every axis by a thin margin.
